This is an auspicious moment!|[[Jianxin]]}} '''Thus Says the Moon''' is an event-exclusive [[Point of Interest|point of interest]] located in [[Taoyuan Vale]], [[Central Plains]], [[Huanglong]] during the [[By Moon's Grace]] event. Players can visit every day during the event for a buff that lasts until the [[Reset|daily reset]]. ==NPCs== * [[Uncle Dong]] ==Descriptions== {{Description|"Thus Says the Moon" is where you get a taste of Huanglong's traditional fortune-telling. What wonders does the moon's reflection in the water predict for you? If you're not really into that, other divination methods such as reading fortune are also available.
{{Color|#a5a19d|Build or Upgrade this stall to gain more Popularity. Visit the stall to experience the mini-games for daily buffs.}}|[[Map]] description}} Thus Says the Moon Location.png|Location ===Possible Buffs=== {|class="article-table" ! Buff !! Effect |- |Horn|| Reduces stamina consumption by 15% |- |Neck|| Increases attack by 12% |- |Root|| Increases energy regen by 15% |- |Room|| Increases crit. rate by 8% |- |Heart|| Increases crit. damage by 16% |- |Tail|| Reduces the cooldown of Grapple by 25% |- |Winnowing Basket|| Increases the drop rate of Echoes by 20% |} ==Dialogue== {{Transclude|Uncle Dong|By Moon's Grace}} ==Trivia== *The daily buffs' names correlate to the seven mansions of the Azure Dragon: Horn (角), Neck (亢), Root (氐), Room (房), Heart (心), Tail (尾), and the Winnowing Basket (箕). Sentinel Jué represents Horn, and Sentinel Hsin represents Heart. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Thus Says the Moon |zhs = 卜问月 |zht = 卜問月 |ja = 問月占い |ko = 달점 |es = Adivinación lunar |fr = Ainsi parlait la Lune |de = Mond-Weissagung }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.2}} ==Navigation== {{PoI Navbox|Huanglong}}
